title: Proceedings Eighth International Workshop on Formal Methods for Autonomous Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.21375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This EPTCS volume contains the papers from the Eighth International Workshop on Formal Methods for Autonomous Systems (FMAS 2026), which was held on the 17th and 18th of November 2026. FMAS 2026 was co-located with the 27th International Conference on Formal Engineering Methods (ICFEM), and hosted at the Leonardo Royal Grand Harbour Hotel in Southampton.

translated_title: 第八届自主系统形式化方法国际研讨会论文集
translated_abstract: 本EPTCS卷收录了第八届自主系统形式化方法国际研讨会（FMAS 2026）的论文，该研讨会于2026年11月17日和18日举行。FMAS 2026与第27届国际形式化工程方法会议（ICFEM）联合举办，会议地点设在南安普顿的Leonardo Royal Grand Harbour酒店。
tldr: 本论文集收录了2026年11月在南安普顿与ICFEM会议联合举办的第八届自主系统形式化方法国际研讨会（FMAS 2026）的论文。
en_tdlr: This volume collects papers from the Eighth International Workshop on Formal Methods for Autonomous Systems (FMAS 2026), held in Southampton in November 2026 and co-located with ICFEM.
